{{Top|leg}}
'''Sith shadow-ghouls''' were members of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] that had their bodies animated by the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Destructors|entity]] [[Abeloth]] through the use of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Abeloth deployed several [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] shadow-ghouls against the [[New Jedi Order]] when the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Assault on the New Jedi Temple|assaulted]] the Sith in the [[New Jedi Temple]] on the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[44 ABY]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Saba Sebatyne]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Tahiri Veila]] and survivors of [[Void Jumper]]s led by [[Sergeant major/Legends|Sergeant Major]] [[Gef Olazon]] fought some on their way to destroy [[Abeloth]] inside [[Jedi Temple Computer Core room]]. The only way to stop constantly emerging shadow-ghouls, were to close eyes of their animated host bodies. Their speed and harming power was much reduced once [[Darth Krayt]] began to drain Abeloth.<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref>
